dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Kshahrewar encompasses many sub-genres. Architecture is just one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: If I studied architecture, I could explain how the lighthouse works to you... Unfortunately, I didn't.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: Oh, speaking of architecture, go to northern Sumeru City and see the Palace of Alcazarzaray if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: The Palace is the masterpiece of Mr. Kaveh, who graduated from Kshahrewar with honors. It's magnificent and exquisite.

dialogues.speaker: Araby
dialogues.text: It's said to be commissioned by a filthy rich merchant, but I have no clue who that is, so I've got nothing more to tell you.
